subject: Re: Kickoff: BLT auto-layout for report and dashboard templates
body:
Dmitri,

Plan:

Staffing: Efe 35% as modeling lead (he ramps in June when his other commitment tapers; until then Wanjiru fronts the training runs), Wanjiru 50% on training + the conda/pip environment pinning, Emeka 40% on the JSON dataset preparation — RICO, PubLayNet, COCO and Magazine all need converting to the release's JSON format — and Oyin 30% on the internal template-schema mapping.

Compute: reproduction runs fit on 16 Titan A100s best-effort. For the endgame we're set: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-07-06 — for the final training sweep across the four public datasets. Sized for all dataset/config combinations with two retries each.

One planning note: that sweep week starts right after the Corpus v2 freeze on Jul 10 hits mid-week — our datasets are all public-side so we're unaffected, but if you want internal template data in the training mix, it must be ingested before the freeze, i.e. decision by Jun 26.

Deshawn
